name: Vineet R. Kamat
title: John L. Tishman Family Professor of Construction Management and Sustainability
fitReason: Concrete embodied AI and physically grounded human collaboration: foundation-model semantic search plus belief-space navigation, complemented by actual shared-control manipulation. A focused perception/planning project can use CS methods without requiring a construction-only background.

physicalEvidence.summary: OpenGuide (September 2025) uses an actual TurtleBot 2-based GuideBot with ZED RGB-D, language/vision models and POMDP/POUCT-based search in an apartment and office: 48 physical trials, 26 end-to-end search successes. It finds/localizes objects; grasping and carrying them were not demonstrated. KUKAloha (March 2026) additionally evaluates actual 6-DoF KUKA shared-control pickup with human coarse positioning and AprilTag-based autonomous fine alignment. Its learned-policy extension is future work, not the current control method.
